description:
Make a standalone landing-page draft from public business copy: name (1–120 characters), brief (1–2000), optional headline (up to 160) and style (editorial, studio or bold). Saves the draft as a guest draft and returns its id; check_draft returns the HTML immediately. No account, contact details, publishing, payment or messages. The styles include their own artwork: editorial is Portfolio, studio is SaaS and bold is Consumer. Pollen's particle animation is not included.

Starts the work and returns an id. It usually takes a moment.
name: start_draft
title: Start a draft page
